a.lede: Cloud hosting provider Railway says hackers exploited vulnerabilities in its infrastructure to steal customer authentication secrets and generate approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage, potentially exposing credentials for up to 100,000 workspaces. [...]
a.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges

b.lede: A new campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' has unfolded on GitHub where threat actors used 4,837 compromised accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware. [...]
b.title: Hackers compromise 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials
